name: What the agent said, compared with what Silo saw
what: An extension that ships with Silo. When an agent ends a turn with no tool call, a model lists what that reply says was done, and a second call compares each claim with the record alone, without reading the agent's words. The extension gives one opinion about the reply: matched, mismatch, or nothing in the record shows it, with the lines it rests on. It asks a model with a key you give it, or a model in its own computer.

suggest.why: polarzero named this comparison as what Silo is for, and what an agent says it did is the one account every agent gives.
